summary: Iteration 142: checked the new page chip position (bottom-LEFT, inside the footer band), the return of BOTTOM_SAFE to 28mm, the big QR floor of 30mm, the orphan-page guard scan (k=5..30) and whether the signature block ever splits. I measured everything in the PDF with pymupdf through POST /api/letters/preview-pdf as admin. New suite test_letters_page_chip_iter142.py: 11/12 passed. iter139 regression: 8 passed, 1 skipped. Results: the chip is at x=18-50mm (margin_side) and y=6.00-15.00mm on every page, 32mm wide with the mini QR at the left inside it, or 22mm wide with no QR when qr_enabled=false. It sits in front of the custom footer image, and there are no collisions with text, images or drawings for k=12/20/25/40. 1-page letters have no chip. Body text on page 1 now ends at 30.2-30.9mm from the bottom for every k from 15 to 45. With iter141's BOTTOM_SAFE=37 it was higher, so the change took effect and nothing regressed. The big QR never goes below 30.0mm and never touches the chip. With qr_style=footer the last page gets no duplicate mini QR. The signature block (title + name, with or without a signature image) was never split across pages for any k from 5 to 30, and X-Sig-Page always matched the last page. One real failure: with a signature image (signature_base64) and k=10, page 2 holds only the signature block and QR. The orphan guard does not catch it (details in rca).

minor.issue: With a signature image and k=10 paragraphs, the signature ends up alone on page 2 (orphan page). The auto-shrink tries every leading from 1.5 down to 1.05 and all of them fail. It needs leading <= 1.0, which is below the 0.7x floor. Cause: ensure(34mm) for the signature-with-image block plus BOTTOM_SAFE 28mm requires the closing line to end at least about 76mm from the bottom.

Widow at k=11 (with or without a signature image): the last page holds only the final tail line of the last paragraph, then the closing and signature. The guard counts this as not orphan because body_end_page_idx == sig_page. It is acceptable by the current definition but visually weak.

The docstring says the chip is hidden when mini_qr/continuation are disabled. In practice the chip is ALWAYS drawn when n>1: continuation only controls the header text, and mini_qr only removes the QR (the chip shrinks to 22mm). There is no user setting that hides the chip so the footer shows in full on multipage letters. User requirement (2) is therefore only met for 1-page letters.

The centered contact text has its baseline at 16mm and the chip top is at 15mm. The text bbox (13.99-19.57mm) dips about 1mm into the chip's vertical range. Medium-length contact text spans x=25-185mm, so it sits right on top of the chip with no visible gap. Very long contact text (no wrapping) overflows the page width (-1.2 to 211mm) and touches the chip.

Intended behaviour, but worth knowing: the chip sits in front of the footer image's leftmost 18-50mm. Any icon or text in that strip of a real footer image is partly covered. With the synthetic 15-icon strip, the 2nd icon was half covered.
With a 40-paragraph body, the HR letter's last page (5/5) contains only the signature block. HR letters have no orphan-page guard. The chip itself is fine (x=22-44mm, y=6-15mm, no collisions).

issues: The 'يُتبع…' / 'التحقق من الأصالة' sub-line is 5.5pt grey (0.5,0.52,0.55) on a light green chip: very small and low contrast, barely readable when printed
Otherwise the chip matches the reference image: green rounded chip at bottom-left, mini QR at its left, 'صفحة n من N' bold green on the right

critical_code_review_comments: build_letter_pdf retries up to 7 full renders. That is acceptable, but the floor (0.7x) cannot solve cases where the fixed reservations (closing gap + 34mm signature + 28mm safe area) are larger than what leading compression can recover
letter_pdf.py is 482 lines and the inline footer/ensure closures are getting complex. Consider extracting the pagination helpers
With qr_style=footer the footer QR sits at LM, 24-38mm, directly above the chip at LM, 6-15mm. They do not overlap (verified), but they are visually stacked on the same left column
context_for_next_testing_agent: Chip is now at bottom-left: x=margin_side(18mm)..+32mm (22mm when qr_enabled=false), y=6-15mm. It is detected by fill colour (0.93,0.97,0.93) via chip() in test_letters_page_chip_iter140.py. iter140/141 test files assume the old position (right, 24-33mm) and are now obsolete. Find the big QR by filtering images with x0>150mm, because the header logo is 28mm wide. Use a Latin signatory_title (SIGTITLEX), because Arabic text extraction is shaped. debug_orphan_iter142.py runs build_letter_pdf in-process and prints each trial's meta.
rca of the issue: Orphan signature with a signature image: the BOTTOM_SAFE=28mm check in ensure((34 if sig_img else 20)*mm) after gap_signature means the closing must end at least about 76mm from the bottom. For k=10 at leading 1.5 the closing ends at about 37mm. Each 5% leading step only gains about 1mm per line (about 20 lines), so even at 1.05 (0.7x) the closing ends at about 71.5mm. That is still short, so all 7 trials are orphans and the first trial is returned. Explicit body_leading=1.0 puts the closing at 76.3mm and everything fits on 1 page, which confirms the threshold.
